endorsements.name: Bryan Eastes
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-3040
endorsements.description: An unsafe deserialization vulnerability in Bridgecrew Checkov by Prisma Cloud allows arbitrary code execution when processing a malicious terraform file. This issue impacts Checkov 2.0 versions earlier than Checkov 2.0.139. Checkov 1.0 versions are not impacted.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.7)

endorsements.name: Bryan Eastes
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-2180
endorsements.description:
An unsafe deserialization vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Checkov by Prisma® Cloud allows an authenticated user to execute arbitrary code as a non administrative user by scanning a malicious terraform file when using Checkov in Prisma® Cloud.

This issue impacts Checkov 3.0 versions earlier than Checkov 3.2.415.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 4.8)
